record.question: Which among the following irregularities vitiate the proceedings? If any Magistrate not empowered by law to do any of the following things, namely
options: to issue a search-warrant under section 94
to order, under section 155, the police to investigate an offence
to hold an inquest under section 176
attaches and sells property under section 83
record.explanation: Attaching and selling property under section 83 by an unempowered Magistrate vitiates proceedings.
